reasons: Datadog takes avg:postgresql.connections by {db}, but the candidate uses sum by (postgresql_database_name); the aggregation differs, so the value per database would be a sum rather than an average across the other series.

postgresql.backends (non-monotonic sum, unit 1) is a plausible OTel equivalent of the connection count, and the label postgresql_database_name is observed in the dataset while db_namespace is absent, so the grouping label itself is correct.
The candidate should use avg by (postgresql_database_name) on the same selector to match the Datadog aggregation.
